resources.string: Create custom blocks to disable app access and notifications, so you can keep distractions at bay.
Boost your productivity by limiting interruptions. Stay focused on your tasks and achieve your goals with a distraction-free space.

We only need a few permissions to monitor apps and their notifications in order to close any unnecessary background processes. Your privacy is important and this app does NOT collect or share any personal data.
Allow apps to post notifications in order to keep you informed about apps blocked
This permission is required to monitor notifications in order to close them
This permission is required to monitor apps in order to close them
Kuria Mind uses Accessibility Service to monitor and close blocked apps, protecting your focus.

By enabling the accessibility service, you agree that Focus: Kuria Mind can monitor which apps you open in order to block selected ones and log their usage locally. Additionally, it will access system interfaces to provide functionalities such as strict mode.\n\nRest assured, we will never access or share any of your personal data during this process.
